metadata.description: Agentic E2E testing for Claude Code: one core plugin with the engine and orchestration, plus domain plugins for web, HTTP APIs, MCP servers and mobile. Install the core and the domains a project needs.

plugins.name: agentic-tests
plugins.description: Core: engine, /agentic-tests:run and /agentic-tests:setup, planner, auditor, verifier and repair agents.

plugins.name: agentic-tests-web
plugins.description: Web domain: ego-browser author, environment operator and executor.

plugins.name: agentic-tests-api
plugins.description: HTTP API domain: curl and OpenAPI author, environment operator and executor.

plugins.name: agentic-tests-mcp
plugins.description: MCP domain: mcpc 0.7 author, environment operator and executor.

plugins.name: agentic-tests-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile domain: Maestro author, environment operator and executor, plus the web executor.
